meta.title: Sweetflow — From idea to final cut, all in one place
meta.description: Sweetflow organises series, films and commercials in a tree of sequences, scenes and shots. Generate versions, approve, comment and cut the timeline with your team.
meta.ogDescription: Powering audiovisual production from start to finish. Series, films and commercials in a tree of sequences, scenes and shots.
meta.imageAlt: Sweetflow: from idea to final cut, all in one place
cta.title: Start your next production today.
cta.text: Create your first series, define levels and statuses, and let the team work on the same board from the very first shot.
hero.pill: Powering audiovisual production from start to finish
hero.title:
From idea to final cut,
all in one place.
hero.lead: Organise series, films and commercials with Sweetflow. Comment, approve and cut with your team in a single app.
how.title: Three views, one flow
how.lead: Every production goes through the Library, the Production board and the Editor. The footage never leaves the app.
how.step1Text: Create characters, locations, props and styles from references. Mention them in any shot.
how.step2Text: Every shot has versions, a status and assigned people.
how.step3Text: Cut on a timeline with video and audio. One click and the sequence assembles itself.
library.title: Your characters, always consistent.
library.text: Group references by character, location, prop or style. When generating a shot, just name the group and Sweetflow keeps the look consistent across the whole series.
library.check1: Reference groups reusable in any shot
library.check2: Generation models in Auto mode (Magnific picks)
library.check3: Share the library with the whole team
editor.title: From the board to the timeline, without exporting anything.
editor.text: Pick a sequence and Sweetflow lays its approved shots on video and audio tracks. Adjust, trim and review the cut with the same footage that is already in production.
editor.check1: Automatic assembly per sequence or scene
editor.check2: Video and audio tracks with waveform
assistant.title: An agent that produces with you.
assistant.lead: Inside every production there is an assistant with the same tools as you. Ask in plain language for what you would do by hand and it runs it on the board: logged under your name and undone with ⌘Z.
assistant.f1Text: Creates sequences, scenes and shots. Renames, moves, assigns people and changes statuses in bulk.
assistant.f2Text: Assembles a sequence's timeline or launches new versions using your Library references.
assistant.f3Text: What is left to approve, which shots need a retake, who has what assigned and how long each sequence runs.
assistant.f4Text: Every action by the agent is a normal change in the production: visible to the team and undone instantly.
assistant.try1: “Put everything in SC010 that has video in review”
assistant.try2: “Assemble SQ040 and tell me what's missing to approve it”
teams.title: Everything a production needs
teams.lead: Statuses, versions, comments and real-time collaboration, all on the same board and with the same footage.
teams.shotsSub: 12 approved · 7 in review · 6 in progress · 2 retakes
teams.c1Text: Pending, In progress, In review, Retake, Approved. Define your own per production and filter the board by status.
teams.c2Text: Generated or imported, all are kept. Mark one as chosen and the cut uses it.
teams.comment1: Can we open up the shot a bit more?
teams.c3Text: On a shot or on a specific version. The thread travels with the footage.
teams.log1: Zchan moved SH0020 to In review
teams.c4Text: Assign people, share the production and see the team's changes as they happen.
teams.c5Text: Every change, yours or the assistant's, undoes with ⌘Z. What you discard goes to the trash.
pricing.title: A plan for every production
pricing.lead: Start free with one production. Grow when the team grows. Generation credits are shared across the whole production.
pricing.p1SubYearly: per month, billed yearly · 7-day free trial
pricing.p1Text: To try the flow with a small production.
pricing.p2Text: For teams producing series and commercials every week.
pricing.p3Text: For production companies with several series and external vendors.
pricing.p3f3: Spaces per client and role-based permissions
pricing.note: Prices exclude VAT. Unused generation credits do not roll over. Change or cancel the plan whenever you want.
modal.name: Name
modal.wlText: We'll email you when Sweetflow is available.
modal.wlDoneText: We'll write to you as soon as it's available.
modal.ctText: Tell us what you want to produce and why Sweetflow interests you.
modal.ctDoneText: Thanks. We'll get back to you as soon as possible.
production.title: The whole series on one board, shot by shot.
production.text: Scenes, sequences and shots in a tree with code, status and owner. Generate versions of each shot, pick the good one and comment without leaving the board.
production.check1: Statuses and assignments per shot, for the whole team
production.check2: Generated or imported versions, one chosen per shot
production.check3: Comments on each shot or on each version
